response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, DLang, and systems background, plus genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective, but his recent professional work is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js/web-focused with only brief, dated C/C++ exposure (2014-2015) and no evidence of Rust, routing/navigation pipelines, or large-scale distributed tiling systems, making him a weak match for a C++/Rust-centric routing tiling role.
strengths: Long-standing personal experience building a Geo-Data/GIS platform (GISCollective) touching mapping concepts
Deep, varied engineering background including low-latency async I/O and micro-services work at Dunnhumby
Demonstrated ability to learn new languages/stacks and mentor others, showing adaptability
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant use was 2014-2015) and no mentioned Rust experience
No direct experience with routing/navigation guidance systems or production routing tile pipelines
Career trajectory has shifted heavily toward TypeScript/full-stack/product work, away from systems-level or performance-critical C++/distributed infrastructure work
